value.rationale: A natural complete classification of the temporal memory of binary ordinal comparisons across the entire integer expanding-map family, with a sharp iid-to-unbounded-memory threshold, exact finite-horizon probabilities, and increasing polynomial correction degree b-2. The digits are iid at every base, so the observed memory transition is a genuine distinction with implications for ordinal Markov approximations. It is not a minor precision tweak to b=3 alone.
